objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled artifact subject to creation, editing, release, versioning, and archival processes in the P&R management system.

attributes.name: documenttype
attributes.description: Classification of document (Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction)

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow status (Editing, Review, Released, Out of Force)

attributes.name: validfrom
attributes.description: Date from which document is valid

attributes.name: validuntil
attributes.description: Date until which document is valid

attributes.name: archiveduration
attributes.description: Period document remains in archive before physical deletion

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that passes through the same release workflow and triggers new versions of the main document.

objs.name: additionalinfo
objs.description: Supplementary information attached to a document that does not follow the release cycle and can be independently published or deleted.

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: A suggested modification to an existing document created by authorized employees without affecting the document's version history.

objs.name: validityextensionrequest
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and confirm continued validity of a document approaching its expiration date.

objs.name: overriderequest
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has valid application.

objs.name: reactivationrequest
objs.description: A request to restore a previously invalidated document to active status.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with defined roles and permissions in the document management system.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to user (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Business Admin)

attributes.name: usergroup
attributes.description: Group membership for authorization and distribution purposes

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: A collection of users with common authorization or distribution attributes.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Authorization or distribution purpose (Reader, Archive, etc.)

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure that can be selected when creating a new document object.

objs.name: distributionlist
objs.description: A list of users and user groups designated to receive notification and permissions for a document.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Formal confirmation by a recipient that they have reviewed a distributed document.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature applied by a workflow participant during document release or approval processes.

attributes.name: participantrole
attributes.description: Role of person applying signature (Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator)

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A defined multi-step approval process with assigned participants and status tracking.

attributes.name: workflowtype
attributes.description: Type of workflow (Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Translation, Acknowledgement)

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific view displaying documents and workflow tasks relevant to the user.

attributes.name: userrole
attributes.description: Role for which dashboard is configured

objs.name: report
objs.description: A structured evaluation or search output of documents and instructions filtered by user-selected parameters.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: User role for which report is designed

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new document object to the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modify document content, properties, or metadata in the system using integrated editing client or office components.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Define and assign read and write permissions to users and user groups for a document.

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start the 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) for a document ready for approval.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply electronic signature to document during a release workflow step, documenting approval.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of a document after successful completion of all workflow steps.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Automatically generate a new version of a document triggered by content changes, property changes, attachment modifications, or approved change proposals.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as no longer relevant to a new document version, to be physically archived after next release.

evts.name: create_changeproposal
evts.description: Submit a suggested modification to an existing document by an authorized author without affecting version history.

evts.name: implement_changeproposal
evts.description: Accept and incorporate an approved change proposal into a document, creating a new version.

evts.name: create_validityextensionrequest
evts.description: System-generated creation of a validity review request when a document enters the 30-day period before expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm continued validity of a document through releaser or multi-participant approval, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Modify a released document, automatically creating a new editing version while preserving prior version data.

evts.name: create_overriderequest
evts.description: Submit a request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has valid application.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Complete the workflow process to invalidate a document, revoke all reader authorizations except archive group, and initiate archiving.

evts.name: create_reactivationrequest
evts.description: Submit a request to restore a previously invalidated document to active status during the archive period.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Approve and confirm reactivation of an invalidated document, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_distribution
evts.description: Maintain distribution list by adding users and user groups to receive notifications or acknowledgement requests for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Automatically send email notification to assigned users and user groups upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically send email requesting active confirmation of document receipt from assigned users and user groups upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by a recipient that they have reviewed and understood a distributed document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document and submit it through release workflow for approval.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Execute a role-specific evaluation or search report on documents filtered by user-selected parameters.

evts.name: upload_file
evts.description: Attach external files or documents to a document object as content or supplementary material.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically make a released document visible to authorized readers in the system and dashboards.

evts.name: delete_changeproposal
evts.description: Remove a completed change proposal from document display after editing is documented.

o2o.description: A document may have multiple attachments that follow its release cycle and affect versioning.
A document may have multiple additional information items that are independent of its release cycle.
Change proposals are clearly associated with and displayed within a document.
Documents may reference other documents through maintained reference attributes.
A validity extension request is linked to a specific document for review.
An override request is created for and linked to a specific document.
A reactivation request selects and restores a specific invalidated document.
A document is created using an optional predefined template of the same document type.
A distribution list is maintained for each document to define notification recipients.
Users are members of user groups that define collective authorizations and distribution purposes.
A distribution list includes user groups to be notified or to acknowledge documents.
A distribution list may include individual persons directly.
A document proceeds through a structured workflow during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation, or acknowledgement processes.
Workflow participants are assigned as reviewers, releasers, translators, or initiators based on their role.
Documents are displayed in role-specific dashboards based on user distribution list membership.
Dashboards are configured and populated for individual users based on their role and document assignments.
